description: Lint and humanize robotic or stiff prose using a deterministic local Node.js analyzer. Eight lexical packs (EN, ID, ES, MS, FR, DE, PT, ZH) and experimental uncalibrated Intl.Segmenter rhythm diagnostics support local voice fingerprinting, copywriting, UI text, and code-comment checks. Use when asked to humanize, de-AI, remove AI slop, tighten or polish a draft, blog post, SEO article, README, documentation, landing page, or UI copy; perbaiki tulisan AI yang kaku, bikin lebih natural, ubah teks jadi lebih natural, cek ritme kalimat dan kata klise. Not for changing executable logic, legal contracts or direct quotations; not a full accessibility scanner or authorship detector. A local, zero-dependency prose linter that flags stiff, AI-sounding writing (stock phrases, flat sentence rhythm, repeated wording) and tells you what to revise. A style checker, not an AI detector.
